description: US recall check in one call across NHTSA (vehicles), CPSC (consumer products) and FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, devices). Look up by VIN (decoded via NHTSA vPIC) or make+model+year, by UPC/barcode (CPSC recall UPC index + openFDA), or by product name with optional brand. Returns normalized recalls (number, date, hazard/reason, remedy, link) newest first, plus anyRecall. PAID: $0.005 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/recalls/check.

q.description: product name or keywords, 3-100 chars, e.g. 'stroller' or 'peanut butter'

vin.description: 17-char VIN; recalls for its decoded make/model/year

name: recall_check
title: US recall check (NHTSA, CPSC, FDA)
